content.short: Liminal Basis runs automated basis-trading vaults capturing Hyperliquid yield sources.
content.description: Liminal packages Hyperliquid's native yield into delta-neutral strategies that a depositor can hold without taking directional risk. Positions can be minted as tokenized strategies usable elsewhere in DeFi while still earning, or built and run directly with self-custody on Hyperliquid. The platform publishes live and historical funding rates per asset alongside performance data, and counts more than 19,000 users. Independent security audit reports are available.
